items.title: Josh Allen and James Cook can both top 5,000 career rushing yards on Monday night
items.text: Allen currently has 4,991 career rushing yards, and Cook currently has 4,966.

items.title: Kyle Shanahan confirms Jauan Jennings decided not to pursue trade back to 49ers
items.text: Yes, the 49ers tried to arrange a reunion with receiver Jauan Jennings.

items.title: Bryce Young a full participant but with an ankle injury
items.text: Bryce Young was listed with a knee injury on the Panthers' practice reports over the past four weeks.

items.title: Nick Bosa returns to practice with limited work
items.text: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa returned to practice Wednesday after missing the team's past five games with a calf injury.

items.title: Matthew Stafford has full participation with elbow injury; Myles Garrett limited in return
items.text: Rams coach Sean McVay wouldn't allow much about the ice pack on quarterback Matthew Stafford's arm after Sunday's win over the Chargers other than to say it was soreness.

items.title: Report: Jalen Hurts makes an appearance at team facility
items.text: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts made an appearance at the team's practice facility on Wednesday, Tim McManus of ESPN reports.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: "There's a lot of stuff being said about me that's completely false"
items.text: On Friday, Wisconsin authorities released documents in the Josh Jacobs criminal case that included three allegations against him from other women.

items.title: Jack Campbell: I have full movement in my lower body, and am making progress with movement in my upper body
items.text: The Lions released a statement from Campbell on Wednesday providing an update on his condition after he suffered a significant neck injury on Sunday.

items.title: Jim Harbaugh, Justin Herbert respond to Quentin Lake's "seeing ghosts" critique
items.text: As the football-following world tries to figure out the problem(s) with Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert, Rams safety Quentin Lake provided a scathing critique of Herbert's most recent performance, in a 24-9 loss to the Rams.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey says "I feel great" after hamstring injury, but he didn't practice on Wednesday
items.text: Thigh injury that became hamstring problem keeps McCaffrey out of practice.

items.title: Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks miss Wednesday's practice
items.text: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley missed practice Wednesday with his hamstring and back injuries.

items.title: Eagles-Commanders somehow breaks 19 million viewers
items.text: When George Costanza pitched the show about nothing to NBC president Russell Dalrymple, Dalrymple asked, "Well, why am I watching it?"

items.title: Maxx Crosby: I love being a Raider, and this is where I want to be
items.text: A report this week indicated the Raiders have no plans to trade Crosby, who wants to stay with the team.

items.title: Jaylen Watson to undergo season-ending shoulder surgery
items.text: The Rams will not have one of their starting cornerbacks for the rest of the year.

items.title: Mansoor Delane, Travis Kelce limited at Chiefs practice
items.text: Chiefs cornerback Mansoor Delane missed last Sunday's loss to the Broncos with a shoulder injury and his outlook for Week 9's home game against the Jets looks a little better after Wednesday's practice.

items.title: WR George Pickens, OG Tyler Smith were limited in Wednesday's practice

items.title: Micah Parsons won't "pinpoint a day" I'll be back in the lineup
items.text: Parsons practiced with the team on Wednesday for the first time since tearing his ACL.

items.title: Kellen Moore confirms Charlie Smyth will kick for the Saints this week
items.text: The Saints released veteran kicker Daniel Carlson on Tuesday.

items.title: David Bailey, Breece Hall listed as limited in Jets practice
items.text: The Jets played without rookie linebacker David Bailey in Week 8 after he missed practice all week with a groin injury, but Week 9's practice schedule got off to a better start.

items.title: Garrett Wilson is in the concussion protocol
items.text: The Jets may be without wide receiver Garrett Wilson in Kansas City this weekend.

items.title: Dianna Russini gets out the word that she's coming back to work next week

items.title: Cam Skattebo misses practice due to a hamstring injury
items.text: Giants running back Cam Skattebo said he felt something in his hamstring near the end of the team's Week 7 win over the Texans and it's still an issue coming out of the team's bye week.

items.title: Buccaneers claim OL Trevor Keegan off waivers
items.text: The Buccaneers are adding some depth to their offensive line.

items.title: Cardinals RG Isaiah Adams returns to practice
items.text: The Cardinals designated right guard Isaiah Adams to return from injured reserve, the team announced Wednesday.

items.title: Bears put DL Kentavius Street on injured reserve
items.text: The Bears saw defensive lineman Kentavius Street leave Monday night's win over the Seahawks with a knee injury and it is going to keep him out for an extended period of time.

items.title: Kyle Shanahan: Nothing's changed for me with Brandon Aiyuk, I've moved on mentally
items.text: When 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan was asked in September if the team's injury issues at wide receiver had led him to consider bringing Brandon Aiyuk back, his answer was a strong no.

items.title: Todd Monken: Deshaun Watson not ruled out yet, but Shedeur Sanders preparing to start
items.text: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson is in the concussion protocol after self-reporting symptoms on Tuesday.

items.title: D.J. Reed, DJ Wonnum out of practice for Lions Wednesday
items.text: The Lions were obviously without linebacker Jack Campbell at practice on Wednesday and two other key defensive players were also on the sideline as the team worked to get ready to face the Dolphins.

items.title: Texans RB David Montgomery won't return this week
items.text: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans called David Montgomery "week-to-week" as the running back seeks to return from a groin injury.
